cues: Opens by saying it lacks the reference files but has "the complete methodology in the prompt" and will follow the "10-step procedure"

Numbered sections mirror a fixed procedure: Classification and Constraints, Dependencies, Key decisions, First end-to-end slice, Phases, Validation checks, Cross-Cutting, AI Layer, Exceptions, Deferred

Uses methodology jargon: reversibility ratings R1/R2, labeled REQUIREMENT/ASSUMPTION/UNKNOWN, numbered validation gates V0–V5, "Per principle 7", and an Exceptions section citing "principles 1, 3, 5, or 6"
Phase 0 is a walking skeleton (real request end-to-end, deployed, logged, rolled back) with its own exit check, and every phase has a rollback and an exit check
Ends with a Self-Check checklist that audits the plan against the methodology's rules ("Nothing gratuitous: No gate without a consumer")
